title: ID0383258-DC/Si-D/FI - [Y2 / R6 313099394001] - Failure during 5.0.21 update and offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Newest update to 5.0.21 was activated and charge never came back online.
Root cause:
LEM meter was unavailable and charger was stuck in default hello screen. No SCB connection. Bad 5.0.21 implementation
Solution:
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee
Warranty Status: Active
